observation.command:
sleep 20; cat > /tmp/kc_test.sh <<'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
cd /workspace
eval $(grep -E "^(LOCAL_USER_EMAIL|LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD)=" .env | sed 's/^/export /')
JAR=/tmp/kc-cookies.txt
rm -f "$JAR" /tmp/kc-login.html
OUT=/tmp/kc_test.out
: > $OUT
echo "user=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" >> $OUT
code=$(curl -sS -c $JAR -o /tmp/kc-login.html -w "%{http_code}" "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/protocol/openid-connect/auth?client_id=local-client&redirect_uri=http://localhost:3000/oauth2/callback&response_type=code&scope=openid&state=teststate" 2>>$OUT)
echo "auth-page=$code" >> $OUT
EXEC=$(grep -oE 'name="execution" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/kc-login.html | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//' | head -1)
echo "execution-set=$([ -n "$EXEC" ] && echo yes || echo no)" >> $OUT
code2=$(curl -sS -b $JAR -c $JAR -o /tmp/kc-login2.html -w "%{http_code}|%{redirect_url}" \
  -X POST "http://localhost:9090/realms/local/login-actions/authenticate?client_id=local-client" \
  --data-urlencode "username=$LOCAL_USER_EMAIL" \
  --data-urlencode "password=$LOCAL_USER_PASSWORD" \
  --data-urlencode "execution=$EXEC" \
  --data-urlencode "signup=false" 2>>$OUT)
echo "login-post=$code2" >> $OUT
grep -oE 'error=[a-z-]+|Invalid.*credential' /tmp/kc-login2.html 2>/dev/null | head -2 >> $OUT
echo "=== RESULT ==="
cat $OUT
SCRIPT
bash /tmp/kc_test.sh
